_comment: Report 008 run record. THE FACTS OF THE RUN THAT ARE NOT IN THE RECEIPTS.
A receipt records what was measured. It does not record when the run was
launched, what was asserted before the first call, which timeout policy the
surface resolved, or that the operator never had to restart. Report 008's
page states those as facts, so they are committed here as data rather than
typed into the generator, and the generator reads this file.
Every field below is transcribed from run-008-fable51.log, whose sha256 is
recorded so the transcription is checkable against the artifact it came from.
The log itself is an operator-home file and is not committed to this repo.
NOTHING HERE IS A MEASUREMENT. No score, no band, no token count and no
dollar appears in this file; all of those come from the receipts.

timeout_policy.resolved_from: the surface policy for a subscription CLI surface
timeout_policy.note: Report 007 measured W-1, a declared 300s policy that a numeric literal at the call site had shadowed to 120s since 2026-07-27. This run is the first release-drift run to execute under the policy as declared.

restart.note: A restart path was prepared before launch and never used. Both cells exited 0 on the first attempt.

baseline_pairing.note: Cell 2 is paired against Report 007's run-2 receipt, which is the one the launch script asserted its hashes against and the one Report 007 published. receipts/report-007/writing-plans-claude-fable-5-2026-08-31.json also exists, is Report 007's unpublished defect evidence, and was not used or modified.
